_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); gas distribution and midstream signals with ONEOK's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'We are the sole general partner and, as of December 31, 2014, owned 37.8 percent of ONEOK Partners (NYSE: OKS), one of the largest publicly traded master limited partnerships.' 'Our cash flow depends heavily on the earnings and distributions of ONEOK Partners.' 'The volatility of natural gas, crude oil and NGL prices could affect adversely ONEOK Partners’ cash flows.' (the FY2014 10-K's own words; it calls no business of the company cyclical, the word appearing only in its billing cycle, so DURABLE, the MU rule); no disruption theme in the registry is live for a midstream company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles': none names gas distribution or midstream), so the watch list is empty

classification.quality_note: 'We are the sole general partner and, as of December 31, 2014, owned 37.8 percent of ONEOK Partners (NYSE: OKS), one of the largest publicly traded master limited partnerships.' 'Our cash flow depends heavily on the earnings and distributions of ONEOK Partners.' 'The volatility of natural gas, crude oil and NGL prices could affect adversely ONEOK Partners’ cash flows.' (the FY2014 10-K's own words; it calls no business of the company cyclical, the word appearing only in its billing cycle, so DURABLE, the MU rule); no disruption theme in the registry is live for a midstream company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles': none names gas distribution or midstream), so the watch list is empty. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 1.52x; +3% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.14; conservative 2yr +38%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -52.9%/yr (worst year FY05-FY14, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -30.3%/yr (Q2 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +2.1%/yr (FY05-FY14 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +45.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY05-FY14, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: OKE (retrospective, 2015-08-21) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.52x (88.3% downside to Bear $4 / +58.2% upside to Bull $54) | Adj composite 2.35 vs market 2.49: gap -0.14 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +3% above the EPP floor $33 (22x FY15E $1.51) | Conservative 2-yr case: +38.2% total (+19.1%/yr) | At 22.6x FY15E the 15% hurdle price $45 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; net margin +5.9% and Distribution operating income n/r in Q2 2015, forward revenues -30.6% (no FY15 revenue guide in numbers, Q2 2015 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a midstream company on this date (CLOUD and OFFSHORE are scoped to IT, ECOMMERCE to retail, STREAMING to TV).
